name: Multi-Location Management
description: Complete multi-location management for restaurant chains. Supports centralized chain management, location tracking, tenant switching, and cross-location reporting. Real-time sales dashboard and location-specific settings.
author: HandsFree POS Team

hub_card.title: Multi-Location
hub_card.description: Manage restaurant chains, locations, and view real-time aggregated sales

quick_actions.label: Real-Time Sales
quick_actions.description: View live sales across all locations

features.name: Location Tracking
features.description: Track multiple restaurant locations with full metadata

features.name: Tenant Switching
features.description: Seamlessly switch between master and location tenants from the header

features.name: Real-Time Sales Dashboard
features.description: Live aggregation of sales across all locations

features.name: Cross-Location Reporting
features.description: Consolidated reports across all chain locations

changes.title: Tenant Switching
changes.description: Added seamless tenant switching between master and location tenants via dropdown in settings header. Core commands: get_accessible_tenants, switch_tenant, get_current_tenant_context.

changes.title: Location Provisioning Form
changes.description: New streamlined location creation form with built-in progress tracking. No activation codes needed.

changes.title: Simplified Workflow
changes.description: Eliminated multi-step activation process. Master can now create and switch to locations directly.

2.2.0.migration_notes: Tenant switching requires the tenant_context table which will be created automatically on first switch.

changes.title: Database Schema Migration
changes.description: Automatic creation of restaurant_chains and location_tenants tables via plugin migration system

changes.title: Chain Management UI
changes.description: Complete chain management interface with location tracking and real-time sales dashboard

changes.title: Plugin Architecture
changes.description: Migrated from core app migrations to plugin-based architecture for better modularity

2.1.0.migration_notes: This update will automatically create the required database tables (restaurant_chains, location_tenants) when installed. No manual migration needed.

update_banner.title: 🏢 Multi-Location Plugin Update Available
update_banner.message: Critical update: Database schema for multi-location management is now available. This update creates the required tables (restaurant_chains, location_tenants) to fix 'no such table' errors. Install now to enable chain management features!
